review_text:
{
  "verdict": "split_required",
  "reason": "The PR contains over 2,500 lines of net code changes, mixing foundational security/governance boundaries (raw store vs. governed adapters) with widespread subsystem migrations (recovery, transport, migration) and extensive lifecycle documentation. The P1 architectural risks regarding raw-store bypass require focused, isolated review that will be obscured by the peripheral refactoring.",
  "proposed_slices": [
    {
      "name": "01-core-authority-tokens-and-receipts",
      "purpose": "Establish the foundational security boundaries by introducing crate-private authority tokens and expanding the published store authority receipt view to address P1 concerns.",
      "paths": [
        "adl-runtime/src/distributed/certificates.rs",
        "adl-runtime/src/distributed/fencing.rs",
        "adl-runtime/src/distributed/lease.rs",
        "adl-runtime/src/distributed/authority_protocol.rs"
      ],
      "depends_on": [],
      "validation": "Verify that raw store methods (open, activate, authorize, revoke, commit) now require the new token types. Verify the receipt view exposes the required fields (lineage, action class, adapter version, published generation, canonical result digest, receipt digest).",
      "risk": "High - This forms the bedrock of the security model. Mistakes here compromise the entire governed adapter pattern."
    },
    {
      "name": "02-governed-authority-adapters",
      "purpose": "Implement the governed authority-serving adapter facades that hold the exclusive right to construct the authority tokens and interact with the raw stores.",
      "paths": [
        "adl-runtime/src/distributed/authority_store_adapters.rs",
        "adl-runtime/tests/distributed_identity_lease_authority.rs"
      ],
      "depends_on": [
        "01-core-authority-tokens-and-receipts"
      ],
      "validation": "Ensure adapters correctly enforce governance rules before issuing mutations to the raw stores. Run the new identity lease authority tests.",
      "risk": "High - Business logic for authority governance lives here. Must ensure no bypasses exist."
    },
    {
      "name": "03-subsystem-caller-migration",
      "purpose": "Migrate peripheral subsystems (recovery, migration, transport, projection) to use the new governed adapters instead of raw stores.",
      "paths": [
        "adl-runtime/src/distributed/recovery.rs",
        "adl-runtime/src/distributed/migration.rs",
        "adl-runtime/src/distributed/transport/*",
        "adl-runtime/src/distributed/projection.rs",
        "adl-runtime/src/distributed/placement.rs",
        "adl-runtime/src/distributed/authority_reconciliation.rs",
        "adl-runtime/src/distributed/resource_weather.rs",
        "adl-runtime/src/distributed/snapshot_catalog.rs",
        "adl-runtime/src/distributed/capability_advertisement.rs"
      ],
      "depends_on": [
        "02-governed-authority-adapters"
      ],
      "validation": "All subsystems compile and pass existing unit tests using the new adapter facades.",
      "risk": "Medium - Primarily mechanical refactoring, but high volume of changes could introduce regressions in recovery or migration state machines."
    },
    {
      "name": "04-tests-and-lifecycle-evidence",
      "purpose": "Update remaining distributed tests and commit all CSDL lifecycle evidence, proofs, and audit logs.",
      "paths": [
        "adl-runtime/tests/*",
        ".csdlc/*"
      ],
      "depends_on": [
        "03-subsystem-caller-migration"
      ],
      "validation": "CI passes all tests. Proof receipts validate successfully via the ruby scripts.",
      "risk": "Low - Test and documentation updates."
    }
  ],
  "architecture_advice": [
    "Use Zero-Sized Types (ZSTs) for the authority access tokens (e.g., `CertificateStoreToken`, `FencingStoreToken`). Restrict their instantiation using `pub(crate)` or a sealed module pattern so only `authority_store_adapters.rs` can create them.",
    "For testing raw stores without the adapter, provide a `#[cfg(test)]` module or a specific `unsafe_test_fixture_token()` method that is strictly compiled out of production builds.",
    "Ensure the expanded published store authority receipt view is strictly read-only to external callers. Use private fields with public getter methods to prevent unauthorized mutation of the receipt digest or generation data.",
    "Verify that `AuthorityLedger::new/apply/authorize_mutation` cannot be invoked via transitive dependencies bypassing the adapter layer."
  ],
  "must_fix_before_publication": [
    "Implement and enforce sealed/crate-private authority tokens for all raw low-level operations in DistributedCertificateStore, AuthorityLedger, and FencingStore.",
    "Expand the published store authority receipt view to include lineage, action class, adapter version, published generation, canonical result digest, and receipt digest.",
    "Remove any public constructors for the raw stores that do not require the new authority tokens."
  ],
  "notes": "The uncommitted remediation addressing the P1 concerns is exactly what is needed, but it must be isolated into the first PR slice. Reviewers need to see the token enforcement mechanism clearly without the noise of the 399-line recovery.rs migration or the 2000+ lines of CSDL evidence."
}
